items.title: Snowman Pair Holding a Knitted Heart
items.alt: Two smiling snowmen, one in a black top hat and gold scarf and the other in a purple bonnet, holding a red knitted heart.
items.description: The taller figure leans toward its smaller companion, whose ruffled bonnet is decorated with pale flowers and red berries.

items.title: Snowman Above a Blank Winter Sign
items.alt: Small snowman in a blue pom-pom hat and red scarf waving above a blank wooden sign bordered with snow, pine sprigs and berries.
items.description: The broad unlettered wood panel leaves room for a short message, with pinecones and red berries beneath it.

items.title: Snowman Face in a Pine and Berry Wreath
items.alt: Smiling blue-eyed snowman face in a long red knitted cap, framed by pine needles, blue berries and pinecones.
items.description: The curved greenery follows the lower face while the long snowflake-patterned cap falls to one side.

items.title: Snowman-Shaped Red Postbox
items.alt: Red snowman-shaped postbox with a green postal cap, striped scarf, twig arms and a snowflake-decorated mail door.
items.description: A dark horizontal mail slot and brass-colored fittings sit beneath the smiling carrot-nosed head.

items.title: Snowman Cookie with Teal Icing Hat
items.alt: Snowman-shaped cookie decorated with white icing, a teal hat, purple snowflake scarf and three gold buttons.
items.description: The golden cookie edge outlines the rounded body and branch-shaped arms, with a white pom-pom at the end of the hat.

items.title: Snowman Candle with Green Scarf
items.alt: White snowman candle with an unlit wick above a black top hat, green scarf, twig arms and coal buttons.
items.description: A small holly decoration rests on the hatband, and the cream-colored wick remains fully visible.
